title: Learned WDSat / XOR-CDCL branching
original_requirement: Run learned branching and learned cubing/cube-and-conquer on Semaev CNFs using WDSat m3 oracle up to n41.
acceptance_criteria: Static vertex-cover/standard heuristic/random cube/deterministic cube controls before learned policy.
Unseen curves, systems and sizes; charge training/inference/cube communication; report solved fraction and tail cost including censored runs.
Independently check every SAT assignment and every claimed UNSAT/cube-coverage certificate.

source_supported_commands.purpose: Existing upstream WDSat comparator; requires WDSAT_SRC.

remaining_gaps: WDSAT_SRC checkout/build and learned solver integration need binding.
Direct S4 descent has degree6; upstream WDSat ANF reader known wrong atdegree>=4, so use its m3 symmetric degree<=3 model only.
No trained policy, learning backend or prospective heldout corpus is provided by inspected wrapper; torch not installed.
execution_note: Commands are source bindings, not launch receipts; preserve original trials and output to a fresh location through the applicable runner. No official approval or status transition is implied.
original_audit_text: Learned branching for WDSat and XOR-CDCL on Semaev CNFs. Zero hits for NeuroSAT-style work. WDSat is your best m = 3 oracle up to n = 41 and runs a static vertex-cover order. Cube-and-conquer with learned cubing was declined without a run.
